## Activity

During August 2023, Market Eye Clinic recorded 35 captures. This activity is reported for the month as a whole and provides the basis for the image-quality and grading measures below. Staff raised no new equipment faults during August 2023. No further operational issues were recorded in the information provided for this reporting period.

## Image quality

Of the 35 captures, 10 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 28.6 per cent. This proportion indicates that a defined part of the month’s captured material could not be graded. The ungradable total and rate are presented together to support review of image-capture performance at Market Eye Clinic.

## Grading

A total of 5 results were graded referable. The median grading lag was 1. This is the median interval reported for grading during August 2023. The grading information should be considered alongside the capture volume and the ungradable rate when reviewing activity at Market Eye Clinic.
